title: Fair Risk Control: A Generalized Framework for Calibrating Multi-group Fairness Risks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity in the probability of generating specific categories of words (e.g., stereotyped professions, pleasant/unpleasant words) given prompts with male versus female indicator words in text generation tasks. Additionally, comparing False Negative Rates (FNR) across gender subgroups (male vs. female) in face image segmentation.
Comparing False Negative Rates (FNR) across racial subgroups (white vs. non-white) in face image segmentation tasks.
